text: わしの　かわりに　いって　くれんか！

patterns.name: 〜てくれないか
patterns.explanation: てくれないか after a verb asks someone to do something as a favor to you. くれん is an old-man short form of くれない. いって くれんか = 'won't you go for me?'

patterns.name: 〜のかわりに
patterns.explanation: のかわりに after a person says something is done instead of that person. わしの かわりに = 'in my place'.
